description: Quick fade-in bottom sheet for updating a goal's saved total. Re-skin of the existing progressId Modal — same handleUpdateProgress logic and tap-scrim-to-dismiss. Uses the success gradient because it is a positive-money action.

layout.presentation: bottom sheet, Modal animationType 'fade', scrim tap dismisses

subtitle.text: Enter the new total saved amount

accessibility.label: Update savings amount
accessibility.note: Scrim is tap-to-dismiss; ensure the input and CTA are not inside the dismiss touch area.

developerNotes: Re-skin only — keep handleUpdateProgress and the activeOpacity scrim dismiss. Swap #1a1a2e → colors.surface2 and the ['#34d399','#059669'] CTA → gradients.successGradient. On save, optimistically bump the source goal's bar (animation.medium; may flip status to Funded) before the refetch; snap under reduce-motion.
